title: City Hall Eyes Business Equity, Public Art
summary:
*   Reviewed a report from the M/WBE Advisory Committee, focusing on Minority/Women Business Enterprises and economic equity.
*   Discussed the "Art in Public Places" program, exploring how to integrate more cultural elements into the city.
*   Councilmembers also addressed internal meeting rules and procedures.
